title: What's New: Server and Database (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: New AL methods: sequential GUIDs, lock timeout, truncate
Database optimizations: flow fields and analysis mode
Semantic search in metadata: overview and feature toggles
Semantic search: embeddings, maintenance, and search behavior
Advanced search with natural language and reporting tooltips
Reporting platform: tooltips on report columns and Word addin
Troubleshooting tools: SQL profiling and error details

features.name: Sequential GUID AL method
features.description: New AL method to create sequential GUIDs for better database indexing performance, addressing the performance limitations of standard GUIDs when used as primary keys or indexed fields.

features.name: Lock timeout duration AL method
features.description: New AL method to set custom lock timeouts instead of just on/off, allowing more resilient handling of scenarios that need longer wait times for locks but not infinite wait.
caveats: Still constrained by command timeout which comes later

features.name: Truncate AL method
features.description: New AL method for deleting large amounts of data much faster than traditional delete, using SQL truncate which only locks page IDs in transaction log instead of individual rows. Supports filtering and preserves auto-increment values.
caveats: Returns false if table is not SQL table, if it is system table, if inside try function, if security filters are active, if table has media fields, if too many rows marked, if filters on flow fields, if subscribers to before/delete or after/delete exist
Should not be used if not deleting vast majority of table

features.name: Optimized flow field calculations
features.description: Database optimization that consolidates multiple outer apply operations into a single outer apply for flow fields that sum over other tables, significantly improving performance when displaying many calculated fields in list pages.

features.name: Server-side pivot on date hierarchy in analysis mode
features.description: Analysis mode now supports pivot operations on date hierarchy fields when in server-side mode (over 100,000 rows or with joined tables), allowing pivoting on year, quarter, and month hierarchies.

features.name: Semantic similarity search on metadata
features.description: New capability to find pages, reports, and queries by semantic meaning rather than keyword matching, calculating semantic vectors for metadata elements and comparing similarity. Used in Copilot chat, role explorer search, tell me, and analysis view field discovery.
caveats: Results can change as algorithm is adjusted based on production measurements
Searches degree of similarity, not binary similar/not-similar

features.name: Advanced tell me feature toggle
features.description: Feature management toggle that enables advanced tell me search with semantic similarity on metadata, adding an advanced tab to the tell me search interface that requires pressing enter to initiate search.
caveats: Must press enter to start search

features.name: Preview semantic similarity search toggle
features.description: Feature management toggle for semantic similarity search used in Copilot chat and analysis view assist, enabling semantic vector comparisons for finding related pages and fields.

features.name: Semantic embedding maintenance
features.description: Automatic maintenance of semantic vector embeddings for metadata across all app sources when semantic search features are enabled. Embeddings are regenerated when metadata changes (captions, about text) or when embedding model changes.
caveats: Applies to base app and all objects from AppSource and PTE apps

features.name: Tooltips on report data item fields
features.description: Report columns can now have tooltips that inherit from table field definitions, or can be overridden at the report level. Tooltips appear in the Word addin data picker.
caveats: Tooltips best placed on tables, not pages, for reusability

features.name: Word addin data picker
features.description: New feature in the Word addin that allows picking data with visual tooltips from report fields.

features.name: PDF/UA accessible PDFs
features.description: Save will default to PDF/UA format for accessible PDFs readable by screen readers. Document layouts in Word will be transformed to create accessible PDFs.
caveats: Screen reader support for PDFs is being phased in gradually

features.name: PDF/A archival format support
features.description: Support for PDF/A archival format that is suitable for long-term document storage. German localization uses PDF/A3 with embedding of files of different mime types.

features.name: SQL call information in performance profiles
features.description: Performance profiles now show SQL call information via sampling. Short SQL calls may not appear in the profile.
caveats: Uses sampling so very short calls may not show up
Works the same as normal AL code profiling

features.name: App version in error details
features.description: App version is now included when copying error details, making bug reports more useful.

features.name: Semantic search on-premises limitation
features.description: Semantic search is cloud-only and not available on-premises because it requires maintaining embedding vectors and SQL Server 2025 which is only available in Azure.
caveats: Cloud-only due to embedding vector maintenance
